strategies.name: scalp_long_off_initial_support_after_opening_window
strategies.entry_summary: After the first 5 to 15 minutes after market open, look for the 5-minute chart to establish support, especially around the 13 EMA. Enter long when price pulls back into that support and bounces.
strategies.exit_summary: Take profit quickly at the next resistance or after a small favorable move; do not overstay the trade. The speaker emphasizes getting in and out fast and taking profit once the scalp moves in your favor.

variants.confirmation_mechanic_note: wait for the first 5 to 15 minutes to pass, then enter on a bounce off the 13 EMA acting as support
variants.target_note: quick exit at resistance / small move
